description: This file defines the PurgeCandidateAPI class implementing REST API endpoints for managing candidate data purge operations within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It includes methods for deleting and listing candidates eligible for purging, along with validation rules and service integration.

classes.name: PurgeCandidateAPI
classes.description: API resource for managing candidate data purge operations, including listing and deleting candidates within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PurgeService, instantiating it if not already set.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to purge candidate data for a specified vacancy ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete request parameters, including positive integers and existence checks.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to list candidates eligible for data purging based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing candidates, including pagination and vacancy ID validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception for HTTP POST create operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception as creation is not supported.
